title: Checkpoint harness verifier report
description: What one binding's judge reports (Task 3 research log §6 and §12 T3-D). The judge runs with PACTWRIGHT_BINDING set in a workspace holding only the binding's files, reads the subject's runs, one per target and each labelled with its target by the controller, as JSON on stdin, exits 0 and writes this document to stdout with one result for each target of that binding. Separate from the checkpoint contract format and the run configuration.

assertions.description: Assertions executed for this result; a pass needs at least one.

observations.description: Named observations; the binding lists the keys each result must carry.
